title: acre reference leaves containers out of what a container holds
body: `acre reference` ends each container's entry with a `holds` line. For `group`, `stack`, `grid` and `panel` that line stops at `ruler`, and leaves out `group`, `stack`, `grid`, `panel` and `repeat`. acre accepts a stack inside a stack and a group inside a group, so the line is wrong. A reader of the reference concludes that containers do not nest and lays a figure out flat.
